objective: Decide what evidence fictional Flint Sensor needs before an early financing decision.

sources.title: Development and cash brief
sources.extract: Flint Sensor Ltd has a laboratory prototype and started the cut-off with USD 60,000 of unrestricted cash and USD 15,000 at constant monthly net burn. The next independent acceptance test is forecast in six months. There is no committed financing.

sources.title: Management pipeline
sources.extract: The pitch calls USD 200,000 in non-binding letters of intent signed sales. Those letters are explicitly contingent on a completed test and permit either party to withdraw. No revenue schedule, signed purchase contract, or eligible comparable set is supplied.

questions.question: Give simple runway at the stated constant burn in months.
Give the gap in months between simple runway and the scheduled test.
Classify the claim of signed sales from the letters as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
Give recognised revenue in USD if supplied, otherwise null.
Give a defensible equity value in USD or null.

priority_options.FUNDING: Dated cash bridge and financing through the test.
priority_options.ACCEPTANCE: Independent acceptance criteria, timing and customer commitments.
